component_prop_contracts.Icon.astro: Props: name (IconName: car|phone|check|plus|menu|globe|device|currency), label?, class?. Inline SVG glyphs copied verbatim; scoped .icon rule (stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2). aria-hidden='true' by default; label sets role='img'+aria-label.
